subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: realize set make behave teach praise be treat believe commit An ideal teacher knows the art of (a) ⎯⎯. He (b) ⎯⎯ his lessons interesting. His methods (c) ⎯⎯ convincing and inspiring. An ideal teacher (d) ⎯⎯ his students like his own children. He (e) ⎯⎯ the good work done by them. If a student (f) ⎯⎯ some mistakes, he is not very harsh to him. He tactfully makes the student (g) ⎯⎯ his mistakes. An ideal teacher is never angry with his students. He (h) ⎯⎯ well with all. He (i) ⎯⎯ in simple living and high thinking. He never (j) ⎯⎯ a wrong example before his students.
guide_solution: (a) teaching (b) makes (c) are (d) treats (e) praises (f) commits (g) realize (h) behaves (i) believes (j) sets
